title: DP Table: Choosing the Best Option

blocks.content: DP Table: Choosing the Best Option
Whenever we encounter a cell that has been updated in the previous row, we have two choices:

items: If both objects fit in the knapsack of that capacity, add them both.
If there isn't enough space for both, choose the one that provides the maximum value.

blocks.content: Let's apply this logic to the knapsacks with capacities 4 and 5 units.
Here, the TV and the laptop combined weigh 7 units, which can't fit inside the knapsack with capacity 4. So, we'll only include the object that gives better value for money, i.e., the TV.

blocks.alt: Take the Best Value out of the Two Options
